title: The Cold War
text: The Cold War (roughly 1947-1991) was a prolonged period of geopolitical tension between the United States and its allies and the Soviet Union and its allies, characterized by ideological rivalry (capitalism vs. communism), nuclear arms competition, proxy wars, and a space race, but without direct large-scale armed conflict between the two superpowers. It ended with the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.
